info.title: API.SH: Foot Locker
info.description: The Foot Locker API from API.SH: public Foot Locker data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Foot Locker's search box suggests while typing: suggested searches and matching products (SKU, model number, name, brand, colour, prices, image, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Foot Locker's department tree (shoes, clothing, accessories, ... down to styles) with product counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All products of a Foot Locker category page (or collection id), with the same facets, sorts and product fields as search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A footlocker.com category link or path (e.g. /category/mens/shoes.html) or a collection id (e.g. men-s-shoes).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, rating, name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Foot Locker product: SKU, model number, name, brand, colour, description, genders, sports, product types, width, price and list price, sale/new flags, launch details, supplier SKUs, rating and review count, online/in-store/warehouse availability with the number of stores holding it, every size (dual size, price, UPC, product number, availability), other colours, size chart and images, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 3 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-product

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product SKU (e.g. W2288111) or a footlocker.com product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Shoppers' questions about a Foot Locker product, each with its answers (text, date, nickname, brand/best-answer flags, helpful votes).

M10.5 / W12.0

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Foot Locker product with the rating summary (average, distribution, recommended counts): rating, title, text, pros/cons, date, nickname and location, recommended, helpful votes, badges, photos and syndication source. 20 per page (up to 100).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Model number (e.g. 333263, `model_number` in product), a SKU or a product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevant (default), newest, oldest, highest, lowest, helpful.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Foot Locker US (footlocker.com) by keywords with every facet and sort the site offers. A keyword the site sends to a category page (e.g. jordan) lists that category (`redirected_to`). Each product: SKU, model number, name, brand, colour, price and list price, sale/new flags, rating and review count, sizes in stock, other colours with prices, attributes (gender, product type, sport...), categories, image and link, plus `raw`. Also returns `facets` (names, values, counts) and `sort_options`. 48 per page (up to 100).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, rating, name.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet as name:value (several values with |), repeatable, e.g. `brand:Nike` or `mensShoesSize:10.0`. Names and values as `facets` lists them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Foot Locker stores near a ZIP code, city, address or point: store id, name and label, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, weekly hours and store page link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/footlocker-stores

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: ZIP code, city or address (or give lat and lng).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles, up to 500 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
